contract.task_clause:
Which of the following offers for the sale of widgets is not enforceable if the seller changes his mind prior to acceptance?
Option A: A merchant tells buyer in writing she will sell the widget for $35,000 and that the offer will be irrevocable for ten days.
Option B: A merchant writes buyer offering to sell the widget for $35,000.
Option C: A merchant telegraphs buyer offering to sell the widget for $35,000 and promises to hold the offer open for ten days.
Option D: A merchant writes buyer offering to sell the widget for $35,000 and stating that the offer will be irrevocable for ten days if buyer will pay $1.00. Buyer pays.
